disclaimer: Curated offline subset for educational and lab use. Verify every match against the vendor advisory and NVD before acting on it; ranges here are a starting point, not a patch decision.

cves.summary: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773. With Alias enabled, a path traversal reaches CGI scripts, giving remote code execution as the web-server user.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.4.51 or later. Disable the Alias directive if it is not required.

cves.summary: Path traversal and file disclosure caused by a path-normalisation error in the 2.4.49 change to the Apache core. Becomes remote code execution when cgi-bin is enabled.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.4.51 or later.

cves.summary: mod_proc is vulnerable to a race-condition privilege escalation that yields root from an Apache child process.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.4.39 or later, or remove mod_proc if unused.

cves.summary: mod_proxy_server can be crashed with a specially crafted request, causing denial of service.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.4.39 or later.

cves.summary: mod_http2 can read memory out of bounds when logging, exposing process memory to the client.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.4.41 or later.

cves.summary: Off-by-one in the DNS resolver allows an attacker who controls DNS responses to overwrite memory adjacent to the resolver state.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.21.0 or later, or avoid the resolver directive in favour of static upstream resolution.

cves.summary: HTTP/2 0-RST_STREAM flood allows a small number of requests to consume disproportionate server resources.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.16.1 or later and enable http2_max_concurrent_streams.

cves.summary: Race condition in the signal handler for the SSH server allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 9.8p1 or later. As an interim measure, set LoginGraceTime to 0, accepting the risk of unauthenticated connection exhaustion.

cves.summary: When AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand and AuthorizedKeysCommand are configured, a crafted user name can trigger use of an unintended authorized_keys file, escalating privileges.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 8.8 or later, or remove the AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand option.

cves.summary: A backdoor was added to the vsftpd 2.3.4 source distribution. Opening port 6200 opens a root shell with no authentication.
cves.remediation: Replace the binary with a build from a verified upstream source. Any host that ran 2.3.4 must be treated as compromised.

cves.summary: mod_copy in ProFTPD 1.3.5 and 1.3.6 allows an authenticated user to copy files outside their home directory, bypassing ACLs.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.3.7 or later, or disable mod_copy.

cves.summary: Use-after-free in mod_auth in ProFTPD 1.3.5 through 1.3.7 permits remote code execution, exploitable by any user who can authenticate.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.3.8 or later.

cves.summary: Argument injection in php-cgi on Windows with certain locales allows remote code execution by supplying soft hyphen characters in a query string. Also enables bypasses of a configured blocklist of dangerous CLI arguments.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 8.1.29, 8.2.20 or 8.3.8. Do not expose php-cgi directly to the internet.

cves.summary: The PHP-CGI argument parser honours a query-string option that overwrites argv, allowing execution of arbitrary code by appending a dash-flag to the URL.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 5.3.30 or 5.4.43, or stop using php-cgi entirely.

cves.summary: PHP-FPM with nginx enabled rewrite rules has a buffer underflow in the FastCGI protocol parser, allowing remote code execution without authentication.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 7.1.30, 7.2.19 or 7.3.6. Do not pass raw PATH_INFO through FastCGI.

cves.summary: The AJP connector, enabled by default, is bound to all interfaces and has no authentication, allowing reading of arbitrary files and, in some configurations, execution of code.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 9.0.31 or 8.5.51, and set address to 127.0.0.1 in the AJP connector configuration.

cves.summary: PUT requests to a JSP file execute the uploaded content as code when the default servlet is writable.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 7.0.80, 8.5.6 or 9.0.14, and set readonly=true on the DefaultServlet.

cves.summary: JDBC Appender does not restrict the JNDI lookup, so a non-default configuration allows remote code execution. Requires a separate write primitive.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later.

cves.summary: Uncontrolled recursion in the lookup substitution mechanism causes a denial of service, and on a write-enabled configuration can escalate to code execution.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later.

cves.summary: Incomplete fix for Log4Shell. Thread-context lookups remain exploitable in non-default configurations, including when the message pattern is user controlled.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later.

cves.summary: Log4Shell. JNDI lookups in log messages let an attacker load a remote class and execute code, reachable through any input that reaches a log statement.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later. On Java 8, remove the JndiLookup class. Treat every host running a vulnerable version as compromised and hunt for exploitation.

cves.summary: Debian and Ubuntu packaging of Redis sets an unbounded Lua sandbox and enables the `acl` mechanism, so an unauthenticated client can load a shared library and execute code as the Redis user.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to the packaged version that contains the fix. Never expose Redis publicly; require authentication and bind to localhost or a private interface.

cves.summary: Solr's velocity response writer allows arbitrary code execution through a malicious Lucene expression, reachable by unauthenticated request if the shaded JAR is present.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 8.8.2 or later, or remove the velocity response writer.

cves.summary: Default configuration leaves the cluster reachable and script execution enabled, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to run scripts and read or write the whole index.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.6.1 or later and enable the security module with authentication on every node.

cves.summary: Use-after-free in SMB1 wildcard path processing allows an authenticated user to execute code as root once a share is connected to.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 4.13.4, 4.14.4 or later, and disable SMB1, which is deprecated and unmaintained.

cves.summary: A null pointer dereference in the NetBIOS name service allows an unauthenticated attacker to crash the file server.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to a current Samba release.

cves.summary: A buffer overrun in the PEM parser writes one arbitrary null byte four bytes past the end of a stack buffer when processing a maliciously crafted certificate file.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 3.0.7 or later. Where possible, use -noenc or a non-PEM format to avoid the vulnerable parser.

cves.summary: A buffer overrun in the X.509 email address verification function allows a four-byte stack overflow when processing a crafted certificate.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 3.0.7 or later.

cves.summary: Buffer overrun in the SM2 decryption routine allows remote code execution when processing an attacker-supplied ASN.1 encrypted key.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.1.1l or 3.0.1 or later.

cves.summary: SOCKS5 hostname buffer overflow. A server that responds slowly enough to a crafted request can cause curl to write beyond the end of a heap buffer.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 7.88.1, 8.4.0 or later. Note this bounds a heap overflow; it is not directly remote code execution.

cves.summary: Baron Samedit. A heap-based buffer overflow in the way sudo parses the sudoers policy file allows a local user to escalate to root.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 1.9.9 or 1.8.32 or later.

cves.summary: The 'set' command in the local-delivery delivery agent can be used to inject a trusted header, bypassing the authentication check and enabling remote code execution.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 4.94.3 or later. Remove the use of the local_delivery delivery agent for untrusted senders.

cves.summary: The Jenkins CLI command endpoint expands user-controlled @-style file references, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to read any file on the controller filesystem.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 2.426.3 or later, or disable the CLI endpoint entirely with -Djenkins.security.CliEndpoint=false.

cves.summary: Spring4Shell. Crafted request parameters to a running Spring Boot application on JDK 9+ can change the Tomcat access log location, and under some conditions lead to remote code execution.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 5.2.20, 5.3.18 or later. Where an upgrade is not yet possible, upgrade the JDK to a build that mitigates the class-loading variant.

cves.summary: Untrusted HTML passed to a DOM manipulation method can execute script, because values are passed to a DOM manipulation sink without the required sanitisation.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 3.5.0 or later.

cves.summary: The HTML extension of the option() method can execute script when a value is read back after being set from an untrusted source.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to 3.5.0 or later.

cves.summary: EternalBlue. Crafted SMBv1 packets allow remote code execution as SYSTEM with no authentication. Frequently weaponised by ransomware.
cves.remediation: Apply MS17-010. SMBv1 has been deprecated since Windows 10 21H2 and Windows Server 2022; disable it outright, along with the Null session and guest access settings.

cves.summary: SMBv1 information disclosure from an adjacent attacker, part of the EternalBlue exploit chain.
cves.remediation: Apply MS17-010 and disable SMBv1.
